correctness.rationale: The proof translates published necessary conditions into finite compatibility graphs exactly. The standalone verifier enumerates all relevant primes and all target-size cliques for each M from 3 through 15. No M-clique exists for M at most 14; the unique size-15 clique has product N with N-1 congruent to 90 modulo 330, so it is not Carmichael. Since every composite T-Fermat integer is Carmichael, all support sizes at most 15 are excluded.
